name: Condoleezza Rice
role: US national security adviser (2001–2005) and secretary of state (2005–2009)
summary: Rice favours American international leadership, military alliances, open markets and support for democratic institutions abroad. Her domestic positions combine support for individual opportunity and limited regulation with a traditional view of marriage and qualified support for abortion rights.
